# Growing and sliding frames past 38 digits (critic round 1)

`ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW` (`run`) and `ROWS BETWEEN 14999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW` (`slide15k`) over `m_w34` (20,000 × `9e33`) and `m_n33` (40,000 × `-3e33`); each cell is `count(*)/count(a) min..max` over the window's rows. Spark: 1 or 2 runs; its `m_n33` `slide15k` cells timed out at 300 s at `local[1]` with ANSI off (Spark re-adds every 15,000-row frame), and the remaining Spark frame runs were narrowed to `m_w34`. Main: 20 runs at SET 1 and SET 4. `m_n33` `slide15k` never crosses 38 digits (15,000 × `3e33`) and is the control.
